settlement: First Greater London Authority Integrated Settlement from 2026/27. The Mayoral Decision records just over £500m per year and over £1.7bn across 2026/27–2028/29, approximately 25% capital and 75% revenue. The settlement consolidates previously separate streams across housing, regeneration, skills, community integration and local economic growth.
scrutiny: The Mayor approved acceptance of the settlement and the Outcomes Framework. Senior Responsible Owners for funded strategic programmes receive delegated authority to incur expenditure under the pre-existing delegations for those programmes. The Greater London Authority must report through six-monthly Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government Integrated Settlement Programme Boards; use of settlement flexibilities is also reported there. London Assembly scrutiny remains constitutionally distinct from combined-authority scrutiny.
culture_route: The published settlement description does not make the whole Integrated Settlement a cultural budget. Culture-specific Greater London Authority programmes and borough cultural expenditure must be traced separately rather than inferred from the £1.7bn headline.
